title: CommunityThreadCreatedPayload
description: community.thread.created v1 (OpenVibe.Community server/events.js, queued in the transaction of the change). A forum thread was started in a space. Envelope: subject { type: thread, id }, visibility public when the item is public else internal, priority low, actor the person or service:community.

url.description: The public page, or null when the item is not public.
